H1.established: Correction time starts from reservation creation.

H3.established: The exact moment the correction period ends is included.

H4.established: Correction is rejected even if correction period remains at the exact moment of start.

H5.established: If correction period is exceeded, general deadline reservations can still be corrected.

H6.established: If both general deadline and correction period have passed, cancellation is impossible.

H7.established: If general cancellation is possible, correction period expiration does not prevent general cancellation.
